correctness.rationale: PASS. At fixed N, irrational ell/h gives equidistribution of the two independent phases phi=k ell mod pi and psi=k h mod pi; the scattering probability is bounded and Riemann integrable, so wavenumber Cesàro equals the torus integral. Psi integration after shifting its cosine amplitude yields I_N(z), z=1+b^2 tan^2 phi. For N=1 and 2 the cosine integral produces 1/(1+b) and 1/(1+sqrt(2)b). At fixed z>1 the Chebyshev U_{N-1} grows exponentially in the gap |sqrt(z)cos psi|>1; in the band its sin(Nq)/sin q oscillation has a phase-averaged inverse-square-root denominator, justified by Fourier approximation/Riemann–Lebesgue on interiors and bounded endpoint tails. The resulting exact phase integral is 1-sqrt(1-1/z). Dominated convergence for the outer phi integral yields G_infty=1-(2b/pi)integral_0^1 [b^2+(1-b^2)u^2]^{-1/2}du and piecewise asin/asinh; expansions yield the b log(1/b) and inverse-b behavior. Mathematical statement consistently orders high-frequency averaging BEFORE N->infinity and excludes rational ell/h. Independent sampled Chebyshev band integrals and exact small-array couplings agreed (9 checks); no inference from finite N alone.
